title: Snow Leopard high-traffic polish
lede: A bug-fix and quality-of-life pass across Dashboard, Schedule, Bookings, Items, Settings, and app chrome. Status copy is sentence case, high-traffic actions keep 40px targets, and recovery paths name the actual work.

sections.heading: After-only authenticated Preview
sections.note: No matched before/after pair. The working tree already contained unrelated chrome, settings, and schedule work, so HEAD is not a trustworthy baseline. Captures are ADMIN, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000.

shots.title: Dashboard
shots.cap: Checking sync without a green glow. Overdue banner has rows. Shift titles are links. Notification count sits on the bell. Sidebar role caption is Admin, not ADMIN.

shots.title: Bookings · All
shots.cap: Heading is Bookings, not Active all bookings. Status badges are sentence case (Checked out). Search names title or requester.

shots.title: Items
shots.cap: Search accessible name matches the field. Filters and Favorites are 40px. Items list was still loading in this capture.

shots.title: Schedule list
shots.cap: List / Week / Calendar toolbar and Checking sources. Timeline rows were still loading in this capture. Next.js issue badge is HMR/dev overlay, not product chrome.

changes.was: Dashboard pending-pickup links opened the reservations tab.

changes.h: Sync does not look live before it is
changes.was: Idle label was Sync starting with an always-on green glow.
changes.now: Initial label is Checking sync. Green glow applies only while state is active.

changes.was: Detail badges and search used title case; sidebar CSS uppercased Admin to ADMIN.
changes.now: Checked out, Pending pickup, and Maintenance match the list language. Role caption is Admin without an uppercase class.

changes.was: Global search and settings search both handled Meta+K.
changes.now: AppShell skips /settings. SettingsCommand captures the shortcut. CommandDialog hides the overlapping Close control.

changes.h: Empty and recovery copy names the work
changes.was: All-tab empty said active all bookings. Week empty told people to leave today. Settings search had no Clear.
changes.now: All tab says bookings. This week empty stays on this week. Settings empty has Clear search.

verification: Focused vitest: 9 files / 82 tests pass (dashboard pending-pickup, status labels, decision contracts, sidebar, settings polish, pending-action, operational loading, dashboard motion, booking realtime, dashboard stats/fast-count, settings sweeping, status-color, schedule review/timeline).
git diff --check on touched polish files: pass
npm run build:app: skipped. Preview already owns 127.0.0.1:3000.

Authenticated Preview as Erik Role ADMIN, dark: Dashboard, Bookings All, Items, Schedule, Settings directory. Settings search aria-label matches placeholder. Notifications (20 unread) is the accessible name. Shift rows expose Open {event} links. Checking sync has no green glow.
Dashboard error boundary fired once after a debug useEffect was inserted after early returns (Rules of Hooks). Moved the log above those returns and Retry restored the page.
Schedule list was still skeleton in the after capture; ListView nested-control and week-empty copy are locked in source. Items after capture was also still loading rows.
Debug instrumentation remains in AppShell, SettingsCommand, and dashboard page until this pass is confirmed.
notes: After-only because the checkout already contained unrelated dirty work; do not treat HEAD as the pre-change baseline.
The Next.js issue overlay in some captures is Cursor-browser hydration (data-cursor-ref) plus HMR, not product chrome.
Do not run npm run build while Preview occupies :3000.
Unrelated dirty work (schedule activity feed, user profile, auto-assign, archived proofs) was left in place.
